title: [Misc] Add numpy implementation of `compute_slot_mapping` (#7377)
body:
For prefill, the python implementation of `compute_slot_mapping` is inefficient as we loop over large lists. This PR adds a numpy implementation of the same operation, letting us leverage numpy vectorized instructions for up to 3x speedup with large lists. If the number of slots is small, we still use the python implementation as the overheads from creating numpy arrays are too great and actually cause a slowdown.
